name: planning-with-files
description: Claude Code fork of planning-with-files (Manus-style persistent planning files). Hooks run from hooks/hooks.json (reliable, avoids skill-frontmatter bug #17688) and add local customizations: per-session plan binding, auto-bind on init-session, 临时任务 suppression, and .hooks_mode gating — on top of the official attestation, PreCompact, and security framing.
